decisions.reason: As a net price display plugin closely related to our shop customization work, it fits our existing knowledge base and can be improved efficiently through our in-house development and client learning.
The ERP system interface plugin builds directly on our technical integration capabilities and supports our strategic move toward broader multichannel commerce services.

A price comparison tracking plugin is strongly aligned with our analytics and performance-marketing expertise, so we are well positioned to interpret early customer feedback and refine it commercially.

Because this price comparison tracking plugin is close to our established optimization offer, it benefits from our related know-how and complements our measurable growth proposition to online retailers.

This price comparison tracking plugin uses capabilities we already possess in shop analytics, extensions and marketing support, making continued commercialization and incremental improvement attractive.
The net price reporting plugin is adjacent to our existing ecommerce reporting and extension work, so our absorptive capacity and in-house R&D make it a sensible product to retain.
